subject: dateInput always sends value to server

messages.author: f5beaad2b72e0960
messages.subject: dateInput always sends value to server
parts:
I want to have an optional date field in my Shiny UI but I am seeing that even when set to "" / NA / the input cleared on submit the input sends the current date instead of an empty string or NULL/NA value.  Does anyone know of a way to get it to send something other than a valid date string so I can tell not to use that input?

shinyUI(fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Test"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      wellPanel(
        dateInput("myDateInput", "Date (optional):", value=NA),
      ),
      mainPanel(
        verbatimTextOutput("myOutput")
      )
    )
  )
))


shinyServer( function(input, output, session){
  observe({
    d <- input$myDateInput
    if (d == "" || is.null(d) || is.na(d)) {
      output$myOutput <- "input blank"
    } else {
      output$myOutput <- input$myDateInput
    }
  })
})
